assessment.summary: Useful AR authoring ideas and a documented web component, but reliable AI output and independent real-world use are not established by the reviewed evidence.
assessment.scope: Browser 3D scene embedding and documented AI-assisted scene generation; client documentation and repository metadata reviewed.
caveats: No installation, generated output or device tracking was tested by AI Media Scout.
The software license does not establish the license, cost, availability or quality of the default three.ws generation service and its model weights.
Eight GitHub stars observed during this review are a discovery signal, not the reason for this quality label.
The current package requires Node.js 20 or newer. This reassessment supplements the preserved daily guide; it does not rewrite it.

license.note: The complete repository software license is Apache-2.0; this finding applies to the client code.

results.note: The maintainer provides a browser demo and examples. Their AI output quality and AR reliability were not independently established.

setup.note: The repository documents usage and package installation; package.json specifies Node.js >=20. Reproduction was not tested.

maintenance.note: No GitHub releases were listed at review time. That does not rule out npm releases, but substantive maintenance and support need further review.

independent_use.note: No independent first-hand deployment or creative-use evidence was established in this review.

dependencies.note: Default AI generation uses the remote three.ws service; its operational guarantees, model terms and costs remain unresolved for a recommendation.
